entries.run_command: cd /tmp/pca-test-repo && git log -L:func2:file.c --oneline -1 2>&1; echo '---'; cd /tmp/pca-test-repo && git log -L:func2:file.c --format= -1 2>&1
entries.expected_signal: No extra blank line between commit header and diff when using --oneline
entries.input_strategy: Run git log -L with --oneline, default format, and --format= options in a repo with known -L tracked history. Compare before (baseline) and after (patched) output for blank-line differences.
entries.limitations: Output format differences may only be visible with specific format combinations (--oneline vs verbose headers).

entries.input_strategy: Run git log with -L and --full-diff together. Verify new error message. Also verify old behavior with baseline binary.
entries.contract_probe: diff <(./binary.before log -L1,24:b.c --full-diff 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?) <(./binary.after log -L1,24:b.c --full-diff 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?)
entries.limitations: The old behavior may have been a different error or silent acceptance. Both result in no useful output.
